ideas.pitch: A pure-logic algorithmic puzzle environment with zero LLM auto-complete support, designed to test core programming grit.
ideas.problem_statement: Event Overview: Codathon 14.0 brings a fresh, marine-inspired adventure designed to test creativity, logic, and problem-solving skills through light-hearted challenges.
ideas.title: MarineLogic Sandbox
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the event's core philosophy of fighting skill degeneration from LLM dependence by completely disabling AI assistance and offering raw logical obstacles.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined step-by-step visual code tracer that forces solo developers to walk through their code logic manually without pasting into an AI.
ideas.problem_statement: Philosophy: This event addresses a growing concern: many rely on LLMs to write code, which degenerates problem-solving skills and logical thinking.
ideas.title: DeepSea Debugger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Resonates strongly with judges who are concerned about students losing fundamental debugging skills, providing a tactile tool for genuine mental struggle.

ideas.pitch: A retro-themed marine adventure game where progress is strictly unlocked by solving data structure and algorithm problems entirely from scratch.
ideas.problem_statement: Event Overview: Codathon 14.0 brings a fresh, marine-inspired adventure designed to test creativity, logic, and problem-solving skills through light-hearted challenges.
ideas.title: Abyssal Syntax
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the marine-inspired adventure theme of the event while championing the philosophy of raw logic and struggle over automated LLM shortcuts.

ideas.pitch: A collaborative challenge platform for solo coders that verifies solutions through rigorous test suites rather than generative AI validation.
ideas.problem_statement: Programming has always been about integrating science, engineering, coding, logic, and willingness to struggle through ideas. We want to create a space where participants can genuinely test their abilities.
ideas.title: ManualMerge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals to the organizers' explicit desire to create a space where participants can genuinely test their individual abilities without outside LLM help.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first algorithm visualization canvas built for individual developers to map out complex logic trees by hand before writing code.
ideas.problem_statement: Instead of high-pressure competition, participants navigate interesting logical obstacles and surface with clever solutions.
ideas.title: TrenchTrace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a clever, low-stress utility that helps participants navigate logical obstacles manually, aligning with the event's light-hearted yet skill-focused tone.
